sources.title: cactusfriend/nightmare-promptgen-3 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This is the third generation Nightmare Promptgen text generation model based upon Apple's OpenELM. It's for generating InvokeAI prompts. It can be used similarly to the previous models, and has an InvokeAI node available on Github here.
